Don't go there.
May 2024 • Couples
Came to this institution on numerous positive reviews of Russian-speaking tourists, who were met on vacation. It was a bit embarrassing that all of them, apart from the crocodile and the snake on the spit and the tuna not on the spit, who impressed them so much, mentioned what they could with their alcohol. We are indifferent to alcohol, but we love tuna, so we decided to go. 
Bottom line: this place can only be enjoyed by those who have never been to other unlimited bbq, never eaten or seen a crocodile, never tasted normal shrimp and oysters, and who have in the first place alcohol, which we are indifferent to.
All ready meals taste awfully bad. Prawns are not only tasteless, but also stale. It's worse than frozen shrimp back home.
 From what you cook yourself on bbq, I can tell you there's no way-- everything is in tons of salty, untasty marinade, interrupting the taste of all seafood. Which made even the tuna we came to eat impossible to eat. 
The vaunted crocodile on the spit is soft but wildly acidic. If you've eaten a delicious crocodile, you'll be shocked, too. 
Bonus to other charms are endless flies on seafood (which are raw in marinade), thanks to them you can spend all night on the toilet.
And the bbq is on coal. If you like to cook barbecue in an enclosed room, then such an event also appreciate. We're used to it. Even though the restaurant is open-roofed, smoke from your and a nearby barbecue flies into your face and there's just nothing to breathe. Lida's seafood ended up raw or burned. And the staff with their flipping of grilled dishes only makes it worse and very stressful. 
In general, such untasty and spoiled seafood we have not found anywhere, although we have travelled all over Asia and eaten in a large number of similar establishments...

Very popular and very cheap bbq restaurant.
Dec 2023 • Family
This restaurant was recommended by our taxi driver and it appears to be a popular eating spot. It's very much a cheap BBQ experience... not expensive which is reflected in the quality of the ingredients provided. (The pork meat is very fatty and the beef portions are very small). The staff were helpful in getting us started with the bbq.
If you are very selective, it would be possible to choose enough for a satisfying meal but the temptation is to just dive in.... the restaurant has an almost street food feel to it..... the hygiene is a little questionionable as there was a street dog wandering around the tables inside the restaurant which I saw sniffing at the plates which you use to put your food on.
In summary, excellent value if your looking for a cheap, all you can eat meal. However, in hindsight I feel it would be better paying more for better quality.

Exciting place with significant potential, but many things are dependent on the waiters
Apr 2023 • Couples
We have visited this restaurant twice. The first time it was really great - we picked up the food, took our places, and instantly we were immediately taken care of by the waitress which set all uncooked parts on the grill and kept an eye on it. So at that time, everything was very tasty -especially tuna and oysters with tricky sauce. The second time we came back a week later, but didn't get the same level of "support".It could have been because the staff was busy, or maybe they thought we were "experienced" users already. Greater independence turned, of course, into much more modest taste impressions. Overall, I would recommend giving this place a try, especially if you get lucky like we did on our first visit.

Интересное место со значительным потенциалом, но многое зависит от официантов

Были в этом заведении 2 раза. В первый раз всё было прекрасно - набрали еды, сели за стол и нас сразу взяла под свою заботу официантка, которая разложила неготовое из нашего "набора" на гриль и потом постоянно следила за приготовлением. Потому в тот раз всё было очень вкусно - особенно тунец и устрицы под хитрым соусом. Второй раз пришли через неделю - но такого же "присмотра" уже не дождались. Дело ли в загрузке в тот день или нас почитали "опытными" - не знаем. Большая самостоятельность обернулась конечно куда более скромными вкусовыми впечатлениями. Один раз посетить точно стоит, а уж если еще и повезет как нам в первый раз - то вообще хорошо.
